text:
omar: deploybot stuck on canary tests for v2026.07. integration-suite failing intermittently. holding change window.
ci-bot: TEST RUN FAIL: integration/payment_flow_test::test_idempotency (seed=49213) - AssertionError at payment_client.process()
jit: seed-based flake again? we saw similar with seed 48102 two weeks ago.
alexa: logs show race in test harness when seeding random delays. it's non-deterministic across reruns.
qa-lead: options: 1) rerun CI until green (may delay window) 2) force-test with fixed seed and re-run single job 3) manual-promote previous digest to meet release cadence.
release-manager: window ends in 35m. product prefers not to slip. what does engineering recommend?
omar: quick mitigation - rerun single failing CI job with env `TEST_SEED=49213` and the harness patch that forces deterministic timers. that will take ~8-12m. if it still fails -> promote previous.
jit: I can trigger a deterministic rerun now: `cictl rerun --job=canary-integration --env TEST_SEED=49213 --single`
deploy-bot: retrigger accepted, job queued.
ci-bot: rerun started (job=canary-integration, seed=49213).
qa-lead: if rerun fails, recommend promote previous digest + create ticket to remove flaky seed use and add stable harness.
ci-bot: rerun result: FAILURE - same assertion at payment_client.process(), stack shows timing assumption violated.
alexa: that's bad. deterministic rerun reproduces the bug, means the code change likely introduced a race.
omar: time check: 20m left. options: 1) roll back the new code (revert PR) and promote previous digest 2) manual-promote previous digest now and open rollback PR + hotfix debug on canary.
release-manager: prefer preserving window. approve manual-promote + create hotfix/rollback plan.
jit: executing promote: `deployctl promote --from-digest sha256:cc77dde2 --to=staging --reason="integration deterministic failure"`
deploy-bot: manual promote started, audit_id=prom-3511-01.
qa-lead: adding release-notes entry: "Staged rollout held due to deterministic integration failure reproduced in CI; previous build promoted to keep release schedule. Fix to follow as hotfix."
omar: created ticket TICKET-3309 to revert change on main and PR a fixed implementation. assigning to alexa and jit.
release-manager: closing hold at 2026-03-24T09:15Z. tagging PMs and posting update to #release-updates.
ci-bot: note: archived failing run logs at https://ci.internal/runs/3511112222 for postmortem.
